infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KnowYourPit uses your location to show the current outdoor temperature during live cook sessions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KnowYourPit accesses your photo library so you can scan cook progress images for AI temperature analysis.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KnowYourPit uses your camera to capture cook progress images for AI temperature analysis.
